Published: 23:19 GMT, February 13, 2025 | Updated: 23:25 GMT, February 13, 2025
Antony continued his good beginning with life in a true Betis shirt by scoring the Spanish team in his draw in the European Conference League in Gent on Thursday night.
The Brazilian scored with a good effort to give his new team leadership from the beginning in the second half of the match.
After collecting the ball just outside the 18 -yard box on the right side of the field, the 24 -year -old evaded two defenders and curled up a left shot in the lower left of the network.
It means that the extreme has now registered two goals and an assistance in its first three appearances for the Verdiblancos.
Reacting to the goal in X, previously Twitter, Manchester United fans joked about him rarely had produced this form during his time in Old Trafford.
A user joked: ‘You can’t help laughing. This is Antonio. Are we the problem?

However, one third thought differently, declaring: ‘Antony suddenly being fit in his new club is not a coincidence.
‘Some players do not have the mentality to act in United and he is one of them. He had the opportunity to be good at Man Utd and it wasn’t, he has found his level.
Another wrote: “Antonio turning Prime Ronaldinho since he joined Real Betis de Man United on loan.”
After Antony’s early strike in the second half, Betis was able to navigate the victory thanks to the goals of Cedric Bakambu and Sergi Altimira.
That saw them exhaust as comfortable 3-0 winners, a score that should give a safe passage to the 16 competition’s round.
The second stage of the tie takes place at Benito Villamarin next Thursday.
Before that, Betis is in Action in LaLiga on Saturday, when they receive Real Sociedad.

Antony’s last goal comes later Betis’s CEO expressed interest in doing hello s Permanent transfer in summer .
Speaking to Sevilla de Cadena Ser, Betis’s CEO, Ramon Alarcon, said Antony could be part of his team’s team beyond the end of the 2024-25 campaign.
“I think so,” he said when asked about the possibility that the transfer is made permanent in the summer.
Alarcon added: ‘The other day, United CEO called me. We send you all the movements and details of the player throughout the week so that they can see that we are taking care of their asset.
‘There is very good chemistry with Manchester (United) and with the player. It is a possibility to continue next season, why not?
Antony’s loan agreement does not contain a clause with the obligation to buy, which means that Betis must negotiate a transfer rate with United if they want Antony permanently.
Although United separated with a considerable sum to sign it, a permanent move could be adapted to the club while looking to recover part of their initial disbursement.
